rules.statement: The Supreme Court has the power to exercise its powers of revision on the application of an aggrieved person not a party to the record, provided that such action would prevent injustice.
rules.supporting_quote: We have, therefore, to consider the facts of the case which are these:- The land sought to be partitioned was described in the plaint as consisting of a divided portion of about ten parrahs from and out of the field called Kandanekumbura, But it will be observed that the location of this divided portion in the field is not described either in the deed or in the plaint.
